content: Cathut ni yon a tânae dawk lungmawngnae

content.text: Oe BAWIPA, bangkongmaw ahlanae koe na kangdue.
Bangkongmaw runae tueng nah na kâhro.
Tamikathoutnaw ni kâoupnae lahoi
tami karoedengnaw hah a rektap awh.
A sak awh e ni amamouh letlang man naseh.
Tamikathoutnaw teh amamae lungngainae dawk
ouk a kâoup awh.
Kahounlounnaw ni BAWIPA a hnoun awh teh,
a dudam awh.
Tamikathoutnaw ni kâoupnae lahoi
Cathut tawng ngai awh hoeh.
A pouknae dawkvah, Cathut awm hoeh ati awh.
Lawkcengnae teh ahni hoi ahla arasang dawkvah,
a tarannaw pueng hah a dudam.
A lungthung hoi, kâhuen mahoeh,
nâtuek hai runae kâhmo mahoeh telah a pouk.
A pahni teh thoebonae,
dumnae hoi repcoungroenae lawk hoi akawi.
A lai rahim vah runae hoi payonnae teh ao.
Kho tangkuem lampawp koe a tahung teh,
tami ni hmuhoehnae koe yonnae ka tawn hoeh e naw hah a thei awh.
Tami ka roedeng e hah arulahoi a pawp awh.
Sendek ni a kâkhu dawk hoi a pawp e patetlah
arulahoi tami ouk a pawp.
Tami ka roedeng hah man hanlah a pawp.
A tamlawk hoi a sawn toteh tami ka roedeng a kâman.
Hottelah, karoedengnaw hah a thaonae lahoi rawp sak nahanlah,
ka rahnoumca lah a tabo awh.
A lungthung hoi, Cathut ni a pahnim toe.
A minhmai hai a hro toe.
Nâtuek hai hmawt mahoeh toe telah a pouk.
Oe BAWIPA, thaw haw.
Oe Cathut, na kut dâw haw.
Kârahnoumnaw hah pahnim hanh.
Bangkongmaw tamikathoutnaw ni Cathut banglahai a noutna awh hoeh.
A lungthung hoi, banglah pouk mahoeh ouk ati awh.
Hateiteh, lungreithai hoi runae teh na pakhingpalang teh,
na kut hoi moipathung hanlah na hmu toe.
Karoedengnaw, teh nang koe a kâhnawng awh teh,
nang teh, na pa ka tawn hoeh naw kabawmkung lah na o.
Tamikathoutnaw hoi tamikayonnaw e kut hah khoe pouh nateh,
ceitakhai e awm laipalah, hawihoehnae pueng koung pâphue pouh haw.
BAWIPA teh a yungyoe hoi a yungyoe totouh siangpahrang doeh.
A ram thung hoi miphunnaw koung a kahma awh.
Repcoungroe e hoi na pa ka tawn hoeh naw koevah,
kângingnae sak hanelah,
talai taminaw ni repcoungroe hoeh nahanelah,
BAWIPA, kârahnoumnaw e ngainae teh na panue teh,
ahnimouh lawkceng hanelah na hnâ teh na pakeng pouh.
